chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Abān, from al-Ḥasan al-ʿAṭṭār, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man falsely accuses an entire group. He said: “With a single statement?” I said: Yes. He said: “He is given one hadd punishment; but if he separated them in the accusation, he is given a hadd punishment for each man among them.”

key_terms.بِكَلِمَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ: in a single statement or expression
key_terms.قَذَفَ: to falsely accuse someone of illicit sexual conduct
key_terms.لِكُلِّ رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ حَدًّا: a separate hadd punishment for each man among them
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ حَدًّا وَاحِدًا: he is subjected to one fixed legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the hadd ruling if someone accuses a whole group of people of illicit conduct?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning qadhf, the false accusation of a group. If the accusation is made in one collective statement, there is one hadd punishment; if the accusations are directed separately, a separate hadd is applied for each individual.
